# ScribeCat 0.27.3

- Keep the move-to folder picker compact on phones and collapsed by default.
- Add an action to permanently empty the Trash after confirmation.
- Show the app version at the bottom of the sidebar.
- Show before/after insertion markers while reordering task subcategories.
- Cache remote-vault notes, folder listings and first journal images locally for offline access. Offline edits remain persistent drafts; when they are saved after reconnect, the existing conflict dialog shows the differences before either version is kept.
- Cache journal entries and their first image references in IndexedDB; load cached entries immediately and refresh files whose modification time changed.
- Start Zen mode at the top of the document and exit it with Escape.
- Build macOS releases on explicit Apple Silicon and Intel runners. Configure the `APPLE_CERTIFICATE`, `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`, `APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY`, `APPLE_ID`, `APPLE_PASSWORD`, and `APPLE_TEAM_ID` repository secrets to sign and notarize the macOS installers.
